in_hebrew.name: אָבְנָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Baumann is derived from the Hebrew word 'אָבְנָה' (avnah), which means 'father of the tree'. In the context of the Bible, this name could symbolize a strong and nurturing figure, providing support and growth, much like a tree.

in_greek.name: Βαυμαννος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Baumann in Greek is translated as 'Βαυμαννος' (Baumannos), which means 'son of the tree'. This name may represent someone who is rooted in their beliefs, strong and unwavering like a tree in the wind.

in_latin.name: Baumannus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Baumann in Latin is 'Baumannus', which means 'man of the tree'. This name could symbolize a connection to nature or a protector, much like a tree provides shade and shelter.
